These grips are designed to turn your scorpion bullpup into a p90ish style bullpup. These grips cover the front pic rail and add a foregrip (Check renders). It prints as one piece and bolts together on the factory grip mounting point. Not much else to it - just a fun grip for a totally hated gun. But if you're here, maybe you don't hate it.
